content.summary: GE Vernova (GEV) and TPG (TPG) announced the signing of a binding agreement confirming the intent under which TPG will acquire GE Vernova’s Proficy manufacturing software business for $600M. GE Vernova may receive additional sale proceeds in the future depending on various outcomes and conditions. content.title: GE Vernova to sell Proficy to TPG for $600 million, shifts focus to grid software
content.summary: GE Vernova said on Thursday it will sell its Proficy industrial software unit to private equity firm TPG for $600 million and reinvest the proceeds in grid software.  Proficy, which accounts for about 20% of GE Vernova's electrification software revenue, helps manufacturers monitor and optimize production.

content.title: KKR buys South Korea's Samhwa in $528 million deal
content.summary: U.S.-based KKR has acquired South Korea's cosmetics packaging company Samhwa Co from TPG in a deal valued at 733 billion Korean won ($528 million), Samhwa said on Thursday. KKR said the acquisition is an addition to its long track record of investing in Korean businesses. The firm had earlier backed companies, including fashion retailer Musinsa, energy provider SK E&S and recycling firm Ecorbit.

content.title: TPG to Acquire Irth Solutions from Blackstone
content.summary: TPG plans to acquire Irth Solutions, a provider of enterprise software for critical energy and infrastructure companies, from Blackstone.  The asset management firm said Tuesday it expects the transaction to close in late 2025.  Irth provides cloud-based software solutions that integrate geospatial data with business intelligence and artificial intelligence to offer situational awareness for some of the nation’s largest energy, utility and telecommunications providers.
